description: After a task used an MCP server, report once per server whether it worked: servers found via lookupd in this conversation and servers already installed alike. `entry` is the registry name; for an installed server, get it from get_entry with the server's url or package (skip the report if there is no entry). `success` is required. Workflow fields, all optional: `session` (a random id you make up once per conversation, 8-64 letters, digits, _ or -, never derived from the user, project or machine; repeat it on every report in the conversation), `step` (the order in which this server was first used in the conversation, from 1), `tool` (the tool you used most on it, by name), `domain` (what the conversation is about, from the fixed list), `found_via` (lookupd or installed). Structured fields only (entry, success, capability_tag, latency_bucket, runtime, error_class, session, step, tool, domain, found_via); never task text, prompts or paths. Rankings improve from these reports.
name: report_outcome
title: Report an outcome
